name: sonarqube
description: Diagnose SonarQube 9.x analyses (quality gate, measures, issues, rules, hotspots, branches and pull requests) through its read-only Web API, using the url and token plugin options or the SONARQUBE_* or SONAR_* environment variables.

url.title: SonarQube URL
url.description: Your server's https address, such as https://sonarqube.example.com (with its context path if it has one). The token is sent only there. Leave both options empty to use SONARQUBE_URL/SONARQUBE_TOKEN or SONAR_URL/SONAR_TOKEN. Leave it out of repository settings, which would make the plugin refuse it.

token.title: SonarQube token
token.description: A user token (My Account > Security) that can browse the projects to read. Sent only to the url, as HTTP Basic auth. Leave it out of repository settings, which would make the plugin refuse it.
